name: Father
source:
A wealthy man who is very concerned about appearances. When he accidentally causes the death of his [url=/c100307/]son[/url], he will do anything to cover it up.

In the April Fools' game Agatha's Agony, Father is a romanceable character and a patient in Clark County Psych Ward. [Spoiler]He is currently separated from Mother but continues to cheat with other women, and eventually with men if Agatha does not intervene.

His real name, Harold, is only revealed in this game.[/Spoiler]
